title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
lede: Google is extending Personal Intelligence in Search's AI Mode to Drive, Wallet and the Gemini app, so answers can draw on a user's own files, finances and earlier chats.

points: Personal Intelligence could already connect AI Mode to Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Photos.
With Wallet connected, AI Mode can read account data to help with spending, financial goals and card rewards, but it cannot move or manage money.
Connecting Drive lets answers pull from documents and spreadsheets scattered across a project, such as building a plan for tax season.
Context now carries between the Gemini app and AI Mode, so an idea explored in one does not have to be restarted in the other.
Every connection is optional, and a coming Personalization icon below each answer will show which context AI Mode used.

sections.text: TechCrunch frames this as an edge rivals cannot match: Google's assistant reads data people already keep in its apps, so any third-party personal agent starts without that context.
